verdict.rationale: PostHog's docs strongly claim natural-language operation via its MCP integration — 'ship a feature flag from a prompt,' 'run a HogQL query through Claude,' and stack-trace-to-fix prompts — supporting AI-native, agentic control across flags, analytics, and error tracking. However, a hands-on community report describes the LLM/cohort-creation feature failing outright (incorrectly claiming SQL-based cohorts aren't possible) and causing severe UI slowdowns, directly contradicting smooth natural-language operation for at least part of the product. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that the MCP-based NL commands work reliably across features, and resolution of the reported cohort/SQL failure.
